capabilities: Apply curated syntax color palettes to fenced code blocks
Set independent palettes for light and dark modes
Add optional background colors to code blocks
Toggle line numbers as visual guides
Choose whether long lines wrap or scroll horizontally
extras: Plugin was renamed from Atom One Fenced Syntax; the settings screenshot still shows the earlier name. Manifest says 15 theme families while the README says 16 families and 40 variations.
motivation: Built around the idea that your notes should stay yours: no workspace changes and no imposed visual style, only freedom in how code looks.
problem: Obsidian's code block colors are fixed by the overall theme, so users cannot give fenced code blocks their own syntax palette without restyling the whole workspace.
